summary: An explicit cart remove quantity below 1 is rejected before any request; an unset quantity still removes one unit, and a stdin body is still sent once.
reason: POST /cart/remove ignores the quantity field and always decrements one unit. Treating --quantity 0 or a negative as a single call therefore deleted a unit. The check runs before the client is built so the invalid value never reaches the API.
validated_outcome: TestRemoveRepeatCount rejects an explicit 0 and a negative, keeps an unset flag at one call, and still sends a stdin body exactly once.
